name: Call operands are evaluated in their specified order

input.fixture_ref: Side-effectful receiver, positional, keyword, splat, and block operands record the specified evaluation sequence.

applicability.reason: Blocked by a REAL defect, not a missing feature. C033 fixes call order as receiver first, then arguments left-to-right; the evaluator collects arguments before resolving the receiver, so `Mk.new().make().s(log.append(:arg))` records [arg, receiver]. Two fixes were written and both reverted: each grew every `expression` frame and overflowed the host stack in the non-termination test. Recorded in docs/spec-defects-v1.md under IRIS-V1-CONTROL-C033.

expect.status: Receiver, operands, and block are recorded left-to-right before invocation.
